messages.content: You identify patterns in complete email texts. Respond with valid JSON.

Please write a BRIEF 15-20 word executive summary of the theme "Software and Device Operations" as it appears in the following examples.
['Update your system through this official site if your account has been created before October 22, 2008.', 'Our Technical Division is doing a scheduled Internet Banking software update', 'Abbey Customer Service would like to inform you that we are currently carrying out a scheduled upgrade of Abbey Security software.']

DO NOT write the summary as a third party using terms like "the text examples" or "they discuss", but write the summary from the perspective of the text authors making the points directly.
Please respond ONLY with a valid JSON in the following format:
{
    "summary": "<SUMMARY>"
}

message.content: {"summary":"We’re updating banking and security software to improve service; customers with older accounts should install system updates through our official site."}
